no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Regencell Bioscience is a Hong Kong-based traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) research company. Its programs (RGC-COV19, standardized TCM formulae for ADHD/ASD, the 'Sik-Kee Au TCM Brain Theory' formulae) are investigational TCM formulae studied in proprietary efficacy trials in Hong Kong and joint-venture clinics, not FDA IND-stage drug candidates. No active Phase 1/2/3 trials are registered on ClinicalTrials.gov, EU CTIS, or JRCT under the sponsor name. The company does not maintain a conventional drug-pipeline page with NCT IDs and phase designations.
